strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
(She woke up far earlier than scheduled...@Was the sedative not working well?@Or does she have some kind of resistance?)
All I can tell you is that you're aboard a ship.
A ship...?@But this feeling... It's like we're flying...
(Sharp... She can tell that from the@deepest part of this large ship.)
Fairy, you'll be spending some time@aboard this ship.
You're only permitted to move around@this room and the adjacent sections.
You may take it that way.@I'll also be looking after your needs.@If there's anything you need, tell me.
(...This girl is my watcher...@But why are they keeping an eye on me...?)
There, now I can see the black box.@And next...
Hey, hey, what're you doing, Dr. Wan?!
Investigating the Drift Wing, as you can see.
The Lamaris sweep is about to start!@This is no time for that!
I'm sure the Drift Wing hides@some important secret.@I want to unravel it before anyone else.
Then maybe I can get friendly with Sleeping Beauty.
Hold on! Don't tell me that's your real reason?!
Never mind, never mind. Now, let's fit@a telemeter onto the black box.
Attention, all hands.@We will reach the operation area in 300 seconds.@Mobile units, begin launching in 150 seconds.
Tch, there's no end to them!@What's the status of the civilian evacuation?!
It looks like a few are still in the city!
C'mon, kid! This way, this way!
Damn monsters!@Fine then... Michiru Hanaten's a real man,@and he'll pound ya with his bare hands!
I brought the G-Bankaran@with the G-Thundergate!
The <Steel Dragons> are on their way too,@but they ran into enemies along the way...@I was off on my own, so I got here first.
Michiru, I've got your position.@I'm dropping the G-Bankaran now,@so catch it!
Awright, with the G-Bankaran I've got@the strength of a million men!@Kid, I'll clear ya a path, so get goin'!
M-Mister?!@I'm only twenty, I'll have ya know!
Michiru, hurry up and get in the G-Bankaran!
Here I come, ya monsters!@I ain't lettin' ya do as ya please with Osaka!
Sir, the Steel Dragons' Hagane has arrived!
Our unit will handle the Lamaris.@Have the friendly units pull back.
This is the Hagane, flagship of the@1st Independent Special Forces Unit.@Friendly units, please fall back.
Roger. We wish you luck.@...Sigma 1 to all units! We're pulling back!
All hands, give it your all.@Just like in Shinjuku and Yokohama,@we will annihilate the Lamaris here.
All units, you heard him.@Prove that we can reliably@exterminate the Lamaris.
(If we actually prove it, we'll be sent@on tour for sure. And then my objective...)
Michiru, your skills haven't gotten rusty, have they?!
Course not, Big Sis!@I'll pound that bunch with the G-Bankaran!
What's that robot? It's wearing weird clothes.
That's a super robot Shoko's grandpa built.@It's modeled after a gakuran,@a Japanese school uniform.
Those things merged again, and, uh...@what was it again?@The new code name they decided on.
Yeah, that's it. Will they show up this time too?
It's best to assume so. After Shinjuku,@Kaana types showed up in Yokohama too.@And as they say, things come in threes.
(It may not end with just that...)
The Lamaris near Osaka Station are moving!@They're gathering in several spots!
Could they be planning to merge?!
Wh-what the heck are those things!?
Same pattern as Shinjuku and Yokohama so far...!
(At all three sites, the Kaana types@appeared after we arrived. A third time@can't be written off as coincidence...)
The Hiryu Custom has reached the combat area!
So they showed up here too, huh!
Shaddup, we got our own stuff goin' on.@Anyway, watch it. Take down a big one,@and the little ones... uh, what? Chipmunks?
They're not that cute. It's Lamaris.
Right, right, it splits into those things.@Don't go gettin' beaten by 'em.
As if! If the top boss of the Kansai@Todoroki Union loses a brawl in Kita,@I'll be the laughingstock of all Osaka!
Whaddaya mean?! Who said that just now?!
Don't pick a fight with the wrong person!@Let's hurry up and finish those things off!
No, the pattern differs from an ES wave!
What the heck is that?! A giant Buddha?!
...So he came to this world too.
Bufufuu... Long time no see, Roa.
Debudedabide... So you survived as well.
Same goes for youuu~. If I'd made it in time@for your showdown with Lord Dark Brain,@it never would've ended like thaaat~
...Are you and Crystal Dragoon@the only ones who came to this world?@What happened to Skull Knight?
Like I'd know anything about that guyyy~
Well, how do I put this...@Something real crazy just showed up.
Not a funny joke. Especially the gate he opened.@...Alchemie.
I know what you wish to say.
But it isn't the same thing.
It does feel a little similar, though.@So that's what caught your attention too, Axel.
Yeah. If this is his doing,@then the one behind those puppets...
Bufuu, I figured I'd end up@fighting you lot sooner or later~
So you're one of <Dark Brain>'s lackeys too!
Lackey? Wrooong.@I'm a top executive of the <Dark Brain> Army!
...Lackey or executive, it all means@the same thing in the end.
So what?! If you came to avenge@Dark Brain now, you're too late!
It's not just nowww~. I already went after you before...
That told me everything. The things that@hunted the Kaiser in Asakusa and Sapporo and@controlled those enemies... were your doing.
S-Seriously?! That amoeba bastard@was sent here by him?!
Not only that.@That gate that sent us flying@to <Endless Frontier>...
That was likely his doing too.
No point hiding it anymore~.@That's riiight, Madnet is my pawn~
Then the friendly units that attacked us in space...
Were being controlled by@this Madnet thing?!
Exactly~, to stop you in your tracks~
Why did you need to stall us back then?
I don't need to tell you thaaat~
And what about the reason you sent us@to Endless Frontier?!
Never heard of it~.@I wasn't in top form back then, though~
Was that unexpected even for him?
Buuut, none of that matters anymore~
...If I were the target, he wouldn't bother@striking at this particular moment.@Could it be you're after the Lamaris?
(Guhh, sharp as ever...@But if those guys are connected to those guys,@there was no need to stall them...)
Silence! I'll take you lot on while I'm at it!
...Bufufuu, thanks to you, I'm starting to get it~
I'll let you off with this for today~.@Farewell, gwahahaha!
There's no way to chase him like that...
Kota, take out the remaining Lamaris.@That's what we came here for in the first place.
All enemy signals in the combat area have vanished!
Any sign of the Lamaris reappearing?
We'll hold <TD Hovering> at this position.@Units needing repairs or resupply, return now.@All others, maintain strict all-around watch.
(Now, will this prove that our unit@can wipe out the Lamaris...?)
Whatever you're scheming, if you've shown@up in person, I'll just pound ya flat!
Try it if you can~!@I'll show you how terrifying I am~!
As long as I'm around, I ain't lettin'@ya do as ya please here in Kita!
Bufu, small fry acting tough~!@I'll make you regret it~!
If you were behind that incident...@you've been on Earth for a while, haven't you?!@So why are you only making moves now?!
I don't need to tell you that either~!
Are you saying the gate back then@just happened to connect@to Endless Frontier?
You're persistent~. I don't know anything about that~!
Back then I thought you'd be useful as a key,@but none of that matters anymore~
Hmm, we got a surprising result.
Does this mean...@the Drift Wing's black box@reacted to something?
Mm-hm. Strongly, too, during the Lamaris battle.
Look at the polyline data.@Here and here... the output rose. It seems@to be linked with the main engine.
Maybe the black box itself@is some kind of generator.
Why would that react to the Lamaris?
We won't know that until we look into it.
...Did you suspect there was some connection@between the Drift Wing and the Lamaris?
Nope. I just wanted to solve the mystery quickly.@It's a lucky find. Hard work pays off, it does.
Either way, this is a major discovery...
Captain, two hours have passed,@and there's no sign of the Lamaris reappearing.@Isn't this conclusive?
Indeed.@Commander, may we recall all units?
(Our unit can annihilate the Lamaris.@But the reason why is still unknown...)
(What we do know is that our presence@will likely sway the course of the war...@It's the perfect chance to make my mark.)
Shoko, ya really saved my hide.
Don't mention it. I'm glad I made it in time.
Things're goin' crazy all over, right?@I'll fight with the G-Bankaran too.
That's why I had it sent all the way to Osaka.@I'm countin' on ya.
Hmph, I don't need you tellin' me that.@Michiru Hanaten'll roll up his sleeves and@strip down to the skin for Shoko!
...Strip in front of Shoko and I'll knock you flat.
Kota, I have some questions for Roa.@Come to the briefing room.
Yeah, figured you'd say that.@We learned a lot from this whole thing...
